scenicChapters.title: Nockalm Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2042 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

nockalm-road.story: Out of Thomatal, one way: 41 km, roughly 42 min in the saddle. It goes by way of Eisentalhohe and Schiestelscharte. The highest point is about 2,050 m. Eisentalhohe and Schiestelscharte are open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
